task.goal: In Simple Calendar Pro, delete the calendar event on 2023-10-17 at 21h with the title 'Workshop on Annual Report'
task.final_summary: I deleted the event "Workshop on Annual Report" on October 17, 2023 at 21:00 (21:00 to 22:00) from Simple Calendar Pro. Searching for the title again now returns "No items found."

steps.note: Read the simple-calendar skill, then observe the current screen
Launch Simple Calendar Pro and find the Oct 17, 2023 event
Tap the Oct 17 cell in month view to open the day view
Tap Oct 17 cell at (386,1577) and verify the day title
Tap search field and search for the event title
Type event title into search and read results
Open the event to confirm details before deleting
Tap Delete and confirm any dialog
Confirm the event is gone from search results
Re-read the search results to confirm the event no longer exists
Re-run the search to confirm the event is gone
